subject.title: [Feature]: Show compaction savings and live run time in Control UI

question: Should Control UI adopt these inline observability metrics, and should the elapsed timer represent the authoritative run start or the local send start when those differ?
rationale: The implementation can remain bounded, but the permanent presentation and timing semantics are user-facing product choices that source inspection cannot safely settle.

options.title: Sponsor bounded metrics
options.body: Add checkpoint savings when both token values are valid and use the authoritative session run start with local send time only as a temporary pre-ack fallback.

options.title: Keep secondary details
options.body: Leave compaction metrics in the checkpoint drawer and omit the active-turn timer to preserve the current minimal transcript presentation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded metrics
recommendation.body: Add checkpoint savings when both token values are valid and use the authoritative session run start with local send time only as a temporary pre-ack fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue carries a protected maintainer signal, and steipete has recent merged history across the relevant chat item, lifecycle, and status-indicator surfaces.
